name: Clear Lake Shoppes at the Reserve
summary: Clear Lake Marketplace is a well-positioned community shopping center located at the intersection of Clear Lake City Boulevard and El Dorado Boulevard in Houston's prosperous Clear Lake area. Serving over 175,000 residents within five miles, this open-air center offers a convenient mix of retail, dining, and service tenants in one of Houston's most desirable suburban markets.
demographics: Clear Lake Marketplace serves a diverse, affluent suburban population in the Clear Lake area of Houston, known for its proximity to NASA's Johnson Space Center and strong aerospace industry presence. The primary trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes above the Houston average, including many professionals, engineers, and families with children. The center draws over 175,000 people within a five-mile radius, with shoppers typically seeking convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and services in a well-maintained open-air environment.
description: Clear Lake Marketplace, also known as Clear Lake Shoppes at the Reserve, is a prominent community shopping destination strategically located at Clear Lake City Boulevard and El Dorado Boulevard in Houston's thriving Clear Lake area. Managed by FRP Ltd., a diversified real estate company with expertise in retail, healthcare, residential, and industrial properties, this open-air center serves as a vital retail hub for the surrounding community. The center benefits from its prime location in one of Houston's most desirable suburban markets, drawing from a substantial population base of over 175,000 residents within five miles. With convenient access and ample parking, Clear Lake Marketplace offers shoppers a comfortable and accessible retail experience featuring a diverse mix of national retailers, local businesses, dining options, and essential services. The property maintains strong occupancy and continues to attract quality tenants seeking to serve the affluent Clear Lake community, which is known for its proximity to NASA's Johnson Space Center and strong economic fundamentals.
